_exempt_platforms_note: exempt_platforms lists (os, arch) a component is ALLOWED to miss (dig_ecosystem#2343). An exemption is legitimate ONLY while the platform is UNRESOLVABLE in AT LEAST ONE signed channel (stable or nightly); it is over-broad/droppable only when the platform is feed-resolvable in EVERY signed channel. As of 2026-08-10 (dig_ecosystem#2555): dig-updater's linux/arm64 resolves in BOTH channels, so its exemption was DROPPED; dig-node's linux/arm64 resolves in stable but NOT nightly, so its exemption is RETAINED (load-bearing for nightly — dropping it would red the #2343 gate on nightly); digstore/dig-dns/dig-app publish no feed-resolvable linux/arm64 default asset in either channel, so theirs are RETAINED. The `feedsign --audit-exemptions` drift check (feed.yml PR gate + a daily schedule) REDs only when a declared exemption is resolvable in EVERY channel, and reports a single-channel over-broad as an informational RETAINED note; drop each exemption as its repo publishes that platform in ALL channels. JSON has no comments, hence this sidecar note.
